mod.name: Quick Deposit - Sort Your Backpack Into Chests
mod.summary: Sorts your backpack into your chests. Stand-in summary written for EMF's tests.
mod.description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/5811/images/195/195-1792952024-360509412.jpg[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][b]Quick Deposit[/b][/size][/center]

Stand-in text written for EMF's tests; the mod's own description is on its Nexus page. Press [b]G twice[/b] in your inventory.

[size=4][b]Where things go[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Same item[/b] - first rule.[/*]
[*][b]Everything else[/b], in this order:
[list]
[*]a chest with the same item,[/*]
[*]else a chest named "Bows & Arrows" for arrows,[/*]
[*]else the nearest chest.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/5811/images/195/195-1792952024-495022359.jpg[/img][/center]

The report is in [b]greeneye\quick-deposit\quick-deposit-report.txt[/b]; [b]chat=short[/b] <or> [b]chat=off[/b].

[size=4][b]1.3.12[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A change.[/*]
[/list][b]1.1.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Another change.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
